changelog:
- Initial release of ClawHub Publisher.
- Automates skill publishing to ClawHub with version management, changelog generation, and asset bundling.
- Supports one-command deployment, metadata validation, and CI/CD integration.
- Includes features like publishing history, rollback, Gumroad integration, analytics, and team collaboration.
- Free and Pro pricing tiers available.
summary: Automated skill publishing to ClawHub. Fix push error issue with acceptLicenseTerms support
